research_question: Owner-approved addition: 15 Best Legal Podcasts for Lawyers and Law Firm Leaders. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for legal podcasts, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Lawyers, law firm managers, and business teams in the United States.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; The Daily Beans removed (self-described progressive news podcast, not legal practice); replaced with Bloomberg Law. Above the Law site did not list Thinking Like a Lawyer and lawfaremedia.org returned 403, so both verified via Apple Podcasts. Legal Toolkit and In Dispute labeled as archives. Featured image pending from owner, so post kept as draft.

content_gaps: Top results are mostly single-vendor pages that do not compare published prices on one date.
Few ranking pages show the arithmetic behind a total monthly cost.
value_add: Fifteen shows grouped by the job they do for a firm, each with host and latest-episode date checked the same day, and archive shows clearly labeled so readers know which are still publishing.
